text:
I've built a small Windows utility called Win Stats that shows live system stats directly in the taskbar.

I used to open Task Manager multiple times just to check RAM usage, CPU/GPU usage, temperatures and other system stats. I wanted something that could show all of this at a glance.

It's Similar to the popular macOS app called Stats

It supports CPU, RAM, GPU, disk speeds, network usage, CPU/GPU temperatures and customizable layouts.

It's completely free and open source, with no paywalls or monetization :)

GitHub: https://github.com/VC067/win-stats Website: https://vc067.github.io/win-stats/
title: Show HN: Win Stats – open-source system monitoring in the Windows taskbar
